# pantechdynamics_network (Data Source)

Looks up one existing VPC network by id or name, to place subnets, public IPs or databases in it without managing it. Failed and deleted networks are not found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look an existing VPC network up by name (or by id). Network names are not
# unique: if several share the name, the lookup fails and lists their ids.
data "pantechdynamics_network" "main" {
  name = "main"
}

output "main_cidr" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_network.main.cidr
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the network to look up, starting with net_. Set exactly one of id and name.
- `name` (String) Name of the network to look up. It must match exactly. Names are not unique on the platform: if more than one network has the name, the lookup fails and lists their ids. Set exactly one of id and name.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 address range of the network.
- `created_at` (String) When the network was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `observed_state` (String) State of the network as the platform sees it, for example "active".
- `region` (String) Region the network is in.
- `zone` (String) Zone the network is in.
